description: We serve your zone as secondaries, transferred from your primaries (public IPv4) with a TSIG key that the answer gives once. The same nameserver-pair step as zone_create applies (check first). Paid, no account. Without payment the call returns payment_required with the price, a Lightning invoice and a Cashu payment request; pay only within what your user allowed, then call again with the same arguments plus l402='<macaroon>:<preimage>', or call with cashu='<token>'. Every request is checked for free before an invoice is made; use check first.

cashu.description: Cashu token (cashuA... or cashuB...) worth at least the price, from an accepted mint (see info). Pays without a previous call.

l402.description: Lightning payment proof for a retry: '<macaroon>:<preimage>', where macaroon comes from the payment_required answer of the previous call and preimage is the 64-hex proof your wallet returns after paying its invoice. Use it with the same tool and arguments.

ns_ticket.description: The ns_ticket from the delegation_missing answer of an earlier check or call (secret, shown once, 48 h): proves you got this zone's nameserver pair.

period.description: 30d (30 days) or 1y (365 days). Prices differ: see the tool title.

previous_token.description: The old zone token, only when hosting again a zone you removed or let expire (reserved for you for a while).

primaries.description: Public IPv4 addresses of your primary servers (AXFR source, NOTIFY sender).

zone.description: The domain to host, e.g. example.com (a name you registered at any registrar).

name: secondary_create
title: Secondary DNS for your zone (500 sats 30d, 5,000 sats 1y)
